source: The six false positives of issue #71, verbatim from the Claude Code session transcripts that hit them (session id prefix and date per case). Only change: a leading `cd ~/projets/cyclebeat && ` (or its absolute form) is dropped, since the tests run from the repo root. Each was refused by agent-hooks/pre_tool_use.py at 69b032e.

cases.command: S=/tmp/claude-1000/-home-ellie-projets-cyclebeat/205e710c-ed42-452b-b776-8359dc55aa91/scratchpad && ls -la data/ && (cd data && sha256sum $(find . -type f | sort)) > $S/data-fp-before.txt; (cd lake && find . -type f | sort | xargs -r sha256sum) > $S/lake-fp-before.txt; wc -l $S/*fp-before.txt; cp data/cyclebeat_runtime.duckdb $S/runtime.duckdb && echo copied

uv run python -c "
import duckdb
c=duckdb.connect()
for ds,col in [('tracks','ingested_at'),('resolutions','resolved_at')]:
    p=f'lake/raw/{ds}/dt=2026-07-29/part.parquet'
    print(ds, c.execute(f\"select logical_type from parquet_schema('{p}') where name='{col}'\").fetchone())
    print(c.execute(f\"select count(*), count(distinct {col}), min({col}), max({col}) from read_parquet('{p}')\").fetchall())
print(c.execute(\"select source, count(*), min(resolved_at) from read_parquet('lake/raw/resolutions/dt=2026-07-29/part.parquet') group by 1\").fetchall())
"; ls -la data/*.db data/*.duckdb 2>/dev/null

S=/tmp/claude-1000/-home-ellie-projets-cyclebeat/3b2179ca-915b-48c2-a94e-0061c3f9438c/scratchpad/dod && grep -h "dead link" $S/lint.log; grep -h "Success\|error" $S/typecheck.log | tail -2; grep -hE "^[0-9]+ passed|passed" $S/test-unit.log | tail -1; grep -hE "passed|failed" $S/eval.log | tail -1; grep -hE "passed|failed" $S/contract.log | tail -1; uv run python -m cyclebeat.cli ingest --help | head -12; uv run python -m cyclebeat.cli load --help | head -12

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='tests/test_lake_utc.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import os\nimport subprocess\n","import os\nimport shutil\nimport subprocess\n")
s=s.replace('    """\n    import shutil\n\n    lake_root','    """\n    lake_root')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
uv run ruff check tests/test_lake_utc.py && git add tests/test_lake_utc.py tests/fixtures/pre_57_lake && git commit -q -m "test(lake): a pre-#57 partition rewritten for the same dt keeps no old row, red (#57)

The fixture is the real lake/raw/{tracks,resolutions}/dt=2026-07-29, copied by
the owner (provenance and sha256 in its README). Red on b39a021: the demo ingest
under TZ=Europe/Paris writes 17:43:42 again instead of 15:43:42.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline -1

python3 - <<'EOF'
def sub(p, old, new):
    s=open(p).read(); assert old in s, (p, old); open(p,'w').write(s.replace(old,new))
sub('docs/metrics.md','''the lake ([#57](https://github.com/elliepsc/cyclebeat/issues/57)). Partitions written before #57
hold local wall time; the re-extraction for the same `dt` replaces them whole.''','''the lake ([#57](https://github.com/elliepsc/cyclebeat/issues/57)). Partitions written before #57
hold local wall time. For tracks and resolutions of the demo snapshot (`dt` fixed), the
re-extraction rewrites the same `dt` and replaces them whole; for sessions and feedback, the next
extraction writes a newer `dt` that supersedes them in staging (`stg_sessions` keeps the latest
`dt` per session, `stg_feedback` reads the latest `dt` only). A past-day live ingest or `resolve`
partition is never rewritten and keeps its local wall time.''')
sub('docs/ROADMAP.md','''`demo._stamp` (`cyclebeat/demo.py`) remplace un `generated_at` illisible du snapshot par une date fixe, sans signal. Repli déterministe, mais muet : refuser la valeur. Relevé pendant #57 |''','''`demo._stamp` (`cyclebeat/demo.py`) remplace un `generated_at` illisible du snapshot par une date fixe, sans signal. Repli déterministe, mais muet : refuser la valeur. Depuis #57, un `generated_at` sans fuseau fait échouer `make ingest` par une trace Python (l'écriture du lac refuse une date sans fuseau) au lieu d'un message nommé. Relevé pendant #57 (`dbt-reviewer`, N3) |''')
EOF
make lint >/dev/null 2>&1; echo lint=$?; git add docs/metrics.md docs/ROADMAP.md && git commit -q -m "docs: which pre-#57 partitions the re-extraction replaces; _stamp failure mode (#57)

dbt-reviewer N2 and N3: only the fixed-dt demo partitions are rewritten in
place; session and feedback partitions are superseded in staging; past-day
live or resolve partitions keep local time. A naive generated_at now fails
make ingest with a traceback.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline -1

git -C $P/chessdesk ls-files | grep -iE 'alert|on-call|observ' | head -30
